localChanges: Civilization's Enhanced rules have a new rule, ticked to start with, that keeps railroads as they have always been here: Settlers can build a Railroad on a city's square, and a unit moves for free only between two Railroads. Unticked, or with the Enhanced rules unticked as a whole, cities can't have a Railroad, as in the original, and a unit moves for free from a Railroad onto any square with a road, so a train enters a city for free and leaves it for a road move (closes #1029).

log: A new set, civ1-enhanced:railroads-in-cities, on to start with: Settlers may build a Railroad on a city's square, and a land unit moves for nothing only between two squares that both have a Railroad. It takes the place of civ1-unit's v474.05 rules, which refuse a city's Railroad and run a train for nothing from a Railroad to any square with a Road (civ-clone/web-renderer#1029). Needs civ1-unit 0.1.47.

As in v474.05, Settlers can't build a Railroad on a city's square, and a land unit moves for nothing from a square with a Railroad and a Road to one with a Road, so a train runs into a city for nothing and out of it for a road move. Each is a rule a rule set can supersede by id: NO_RAILROAD_IN_CITIES_RULE, a new BuildOnCitySquare rule, and RAILROAD_MOVEMENT_RULE (civ-clone/web-renderer#1029).
